chunks: The venerable Sheikh Abu Ja'far Muhammad b. Ali b. al-Husayn b. Musa b. Babawayh al-Qummi (may Allah be pleased with him) narrated to us. He said: My father (may Allah have mercy on him) narrated to me. He said: Ali b. Ibrahim b. Hashim narrated to us from his father from al-Rayyan b. Shabib. He said:

I heard al-Ma'mun say: I always loved the Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), but I would show al-Rashid hatred toward them to become closer to him. When al-Rashid went for Hajj, I, Muhammad, and al-Qasim were with him. When he was in Medina, the people sought permission. The last permitted was Musa b. Ja'far (peace be upon them both). He entered, and when al-Rashid looked at him, he stirred and stretched his sight and neck toward him until he entered the room. When he approached, al-Rashid fell to his knees and embraced him. Then he said: How are you, O Aba al-Hasan? How is your family? How is the family of your father? How are you all? What is your condition? He kept asking while Abu al-Hasan would say: Good, good. When he stood up, al-Rashid wanted to stand, but Abu al-Hasan swore upon him, so he sat. He embraced him, greeted him, and bid him farewell.

Al-Ma'mun said: I was the boldest of my father's sons toward him. When Abu al-Hasan Musa b. Ja'far (peace be upon them both) left, I said to my father: O Commander of the Faithful! I saw you behave toward this man in a way I never saw you behave with anyone from the sons of the Muhajirin, the Ansar, nor the Children of Hashim! So who is this man? He said: O my son, this is the inheritor of the knowledge of the Prophets. This is Musa b. Ja'far b. Muhammad. If you want correct knowledge, then it is with him. Al-Ma'mun said: At that point, love for them was planted in my heart.

key_terms.أمير المؤمنين: Commander of the Faithful — title of the caliph
key_terms.أهل البيت: Ahl al-Bayt — the People of the House, referring to the Prophet's family
key_terms.الرشيد: al-Rashid — Harun al-Rashid, the fifth Abbasid caliph
key_terms.موسى بن جعفر: Musa b. Ja'far — Imam Musa al-Kadhim, the seventh Shia Imam
key_terms.وارث علم النبيين: Inheritor of the knowledge of the Prophets — title given to Imam Musa al-Kadhim

ai.seo_question: What did Harun al-Rashid say about Imam Musa al-Kadhim when asked by al-Ma'mun about his identity?
ai.summary: Caliph al-Ma'mun narrates his eyewitness account of a meeting between his father Harun al-Rashid and Imam Musa al-Kadhim during a visit to Medina. Despite publicly showing hostility toward the Ahl al-Bayt to please al-Rashid, al-Ma'mun privately loved them. He describes al-Rashid's extraordinary respect toward the Imam -- kneeling, embracing, and inquiring about his family -- behavior he never showed to any other notable. When asked about the Imam's identity, al-Rashid called him 'the inheritor of the knowledge of the Prophets,' which planted love for the Ahl al-Bayt in al-Ma'mun's heart.
word_analysis: as a means of becoming closer
